cases.expected: NumericIndicator where each value equals original delegate value multiplied by 5
cases.description: Standard case: multiply a positive integer constant. The returned indicator should produce values = delegate * 5.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator where each value equals Num.ZERO regardless of delegate values
cases.description: Edge case: multiplication by zero should yield zero for any index.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator where each value equals original delegate value multiplied by -3.2
cases.description: Negative and non‑integer constant: verify that sign and decimal part are handled correctly.
Invalid input: passing null should cause the method (via createConstant) to throw a NullPointerException.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator where each value equals the original delegate value (identity multiplication).
cases.description: Identity case: multiplying by 1 should return an indicator whose values are exactly the same as the delegate.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator where each value equals the negated original delegate value.
cases.description: Negation case: multiplying by -1 should invert the sign of every value produced by the delegate.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator where each value equals original delegate value multiplied by 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 (Long.MAX_VALUE).
cases.description: Large positive integer: verify that the method correctly handles multiplication with the maximum long value without overflow in the underlying Num implementation.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator where each value equals original delegate value multiplied by 0.0000001.
cases.description: Small fractional constant using BigDecimal to ensure high‑precision handling of tiny multipliers.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator where each value is Num.NaN (propagation of NaN).
cases.description: Special floating‑point value NaN: the constant indicator should represent NaN, and multiplication should propagate NaN for every index.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator where each value is Num.POSITIVE_INFINITY (or an overflow representation defined by Num).
cases.description: Infinity constant: verify that multiplying by positive infinity yields infinite values according to the Num implementation.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator where each value equals original delegate value multiplied by the very large BigInteger constant.
cases.description: Very large integer via BigInteger to test that the method accepts arbitrary‑precision Number subclasses and correctly creates a constant Num.
